next_research_title: Independent nonterminal tactical-miss witness, learned-prior attention and real paired game outcome validation

basis.conclusion: prior contribution supported only for finite synthetic proxy task; no identified reopening effect

scientific_question: Under a fixed trained evaluator, can source-only online rule/probe witnesses detect previously excluded strategically decisive but nonterminal continuations and yield additional actual WDL at matched wall time, beyond learned prior quality alone?
required_work: R1-R10 ten-stage theory research: formalize delayed-regret witness and exact-game-policy confound, derive conditional claim and failed-activation stop rule, literature/novelty, offline toy counterexample, adversarial comparison, validate math, freeze contract

C1-C10 ten-stage coding: isolate clean branch/source, implement native search-only two-ply witness, reject any teacher test-action leakage, prefreeze nonterminal forcing source family and all split hashes
Construct truly independent played-game openings or selfplay trajectories, paired across side/color and source game families; explicitly keep engineered diagnostics separate
Retain trained vs trained full-legal vs uniform controls, add sham/irrelevant activation and all-after8; use same frozen evaluator, same-root statistics and real physical wall-time budgets
Calibrate thresholds only on training/calibration split and never touch test groups after unblinding, record prospective trigger counts
Require at least 20 independently generated activated heldout roots before estimating conditional reopening benefit; if unavailable, declare NOT_ESTIMABLE and stop
Score equivalence class of immediate wins/forced continuations separately from exact finite-budget teacher move
Conduct real paired full-game WDL with balanced openings and two-sided play under identical per-move wall budget, report confidence bounds and game count, no Elo from one-ply agreement
Independent source/model/run byte audit, archive restore test, backup and GitHub publish after every stage and explicit reason for any block
prohibited_claims: exact minimax from Rapfi finite search
Elo or WDL from C15 64 one-ply roots
trained value-network capability of C15 model
success_conditions: independent nonterminal missed-action families, source-registered before model/control adjustment
online witness triggers on new heldout roots and preserves same-root P/N/W/M2 at reactivation
both cost strata <=10% measured wall mismatch with source and evaluator held fixed
positive WDL/forced-regret differential against trained all-legal baseline conditional on activated families with a bounded uncertainty analysis
or defensible negative/null/NOT_ESTIMABLE closeout without metric or source tuning
